_comment: Discord OAuth2 authorization endpoint and supported scopes.
notes: The 'bot' scope adds the application to a guild; 'permissions' is only meaningful together with it.
Some scopes require approval from Discord before they can be used; they carry "approval_required": true. Requesting them without approval may cause errors or undocumented behavior in the OAuth2 flow.

scopes.name: activities.read
scopes.description: allows your app to fetch data from a user's "Now Playing/Recently Played" list — not currently available for apps

scopes.name: activities.write
scopes.description: allows your app to update a user's activity - not currently available for apps (NOT REQUIRED FOR GAMESDK ACTIVITY MANAGER)

scopes.name: applications.builds.read
scopes.description: allows your app to read build data for a user's applications

scopes.name: applications.builds.upload
scopes.description: allows your app to upload/update builds for a user's applications - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: applications.commands
scopes.description: allows your app to add commands to a guild - included by default with the `bot` scope

scopes.name: applications.commands.update
scopes.description: allows your app to update its commands using a Bearer token - client credentials grant only

scopes.name: applications.commands.permissions.update
scopes.description: allows your app to update permissions for its commands in a guild a user has permissions to

scopes.name: applications.entitlements
scopes.description: allows your app to read entitlements for a user's applications

scopes.name: applications.store.update
scopes.description: allows your app to read and update store data (SKUs, store listings, achievements, etc.) for a user's applications

scopes.name: bot
scopes.description: for oauth2 bots, this puts the bot in the user's selected guild by default

scopes.name: connections
scopes.description: allows `/users/@me/connections` to return linked third-party accounts

scopes.name: dm_channels.read
scopes.description: allows your app to see information about the user's DMs and group DMs - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: email
scopes.description: enables `/users/@me` to return an `email`

scopes.name: gdm.join
scopes.description: allows your app to join users to a group dm

scopes.name: guilds
scopes.description: allows `/users/@me/guilds` to return basic information about all of a user's guilds

scopes.name: guilds.join
scopes.description: allows `/guilds/{guild.id}/members/{user.id}` to be used for joining users to a guild

scopes.name: guilds.members.read
scopes.description: allows `/users/@me/guilds/{guild.id}/member` to return a user's member information in a guild

scopes.name: identify
scopes.description: allows `/users/@me` without `email`

scopes.name: identify.premium
scopes.description: allows your app to read a user's Nitro subscription type as defined by `premium_type` on the User object - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: messages.read
scopes.description: for local rpc server api access, this allows you to read messages from all client channels (otherwise restricted to channels/guilds your app creates)

scopes.name: relationships.read
scopes.description: Allows your app to access a user's Discord Friends list, their pending requests, and blocked users. This scope is part of our Social SDK - submit for access here. Social SDK Terms apply, including Section 5(a)(ii) to the data you obtain

scopes.name: role_connections.write
scopes.description: allows your app to update a user's connection and metadata for the app

scopes.name: rpc
scopes.description: for local rpc server access, this allows you to control a user's local Discord client - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: rpc.activities.write
scopes.description: for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's activity - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: rpc.notifications.read
scopes.description: for local rpc server access, this allows you to receive notifications pushed out to the user - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: rpc.voice.read
scopes.description: for local rpc server access, this allows you to read a user's voice settings and listen for voice events - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: rpc.voice.write
scopes.description: for local rpc server access, this allows you to update a user's voice settings - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: voice
scopes.description: allows your app to connect to voice on user's behalf and see all the voice members - only available to approved partners

scopes.name: webhook.incoming
scopes.description: this generates a webhook that is returned in the oauth token response for authorization code grants
